reviews.title: Questionable billing practice
reviews.text:
I don't have any complaints about the app itself — my kid was fine with the content and it seems well made. My issue is entirely with how Lingokids handles subscriptions.
The app defaults you into a yearly plan without making that clearly the default choice, and when I tried to switch to a monthly subscription instead, there was no way to do it. I felt steered into a long-term commitment I never actually agreed to. That's not how a subscription should work — customers should be able to easily choose (and change) the billing plan that fits them, not be funneled into whichever option makes the company the most money upfront.
It feels less like a design oversight and more like a deliberate dark pattern to lock people into paying more. If Lingokids wants to keep families' trust, this needs to change. Until it does, I'd think twice before subscribing.
